quest.title: Irodori Poetry: Part III
quest.description: This time, it is Ootomo who wants to try his hand at writing Mondstadt-style poetry. Who knows what literary sparks might fly this time?
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventurer's Experience x4, Wanderer's Advice x8

talks.objective: Wait till the next morning (08:00 – 12:00) and talk to Ootomo

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Ootomo's poem has really broken through the usual form of the Inazuman poem, yet it also uses its ancient style to depict all manner of unforgettable human experiences.

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Perhaps he means to say that although Mondstadt and Inazuma may seem greatly different, they do share some common aesthetics — just as how the two of us, despite being from these different nations, were able to bond as poets.

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: Ah, to think that you were able to grasp the feelings behind this verse so quickly, despite being so young...

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: I didn't believe in the idea of making friends of disparate ages from yourself before, but now I know that it is true. What a joyful truth it is!

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: #And you too, learned {F#young lady}{M#young man} — that we three should have met here... There must be some destiny at play.

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Indeed. The trip to Inazuma was a pretty bumpy one, but none of that matters now. Even when I return to Mondstadt, I will remember everything I've seen here in Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: This is also thanks to the pictures you brought.

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: I hope that someday, we three shall meet once again.

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: We will!

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: Ah, you're here.

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: Lenne wrote of our regret that we did not meet sooner yesterday, and so today I wish to gift him a verse as well.

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Haha, it is my honor to accept such a gift!

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: Although I'm an old man now, after meeting friends from Mondstadt in recent days, I have grown quite interested in the place.

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: For this poem, I wrote in imitation of Mondstadt's bards, and the verse will also mention some of that land's scenery.

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, I've never been to Mondstadt... But could you help me take a few pictures of <color=#00E1FFFF>Mondstadt's regional specialties</color>?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: Haha, in that case, I'll be counting on you. Just like in the previous days, 4 pictures will do the trick.

talks.objective: Prepare 4 photos of Mondstadt regional specialties related to the theme

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: Well then, how are the pictures coming along?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have them right here.

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: Thank you, thank you. Ah, with these, I can finally pen a satisfactory poem down. Now then, let me think...

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: Here's my draft, written according to the pictures you brought back. Why don't you choose the stanzas we should use?

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Connecting a flower to a lover is common to all nations, and this sentence compares remembering the sights of Inazuma to recalling one's first love.

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Indeed, using "tracing the wind's footsteps" as a metaphor for setting off on a journey is a very Mondstadt-like expression.

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: The wild fruit in here must be alluding to some painful experiences. It is not a purely joyful memory, like the first taste of alcohol or the first reading of a poem, but it nonetheless leaves a deep impression.

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: This line says that though one may leave Inazuma, the things one has seen here will remain in one's heart forever.

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: Well then, how are the pictures coming along?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I haven't finished taking them yet.

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: I'm sorry for troubling you. What we need today are pictures of <color=#00E1FFFF>Mondstadt's regional specialties</color>. Just as before, <color=#00E1FFFF>4 pictures</color> will do.
